Crisp chunky 16-bit pixel-art sprite sheet on a landscape canvas of pure black. Four isolated wide rectangular miniature scenes in a regular 2-by-2 layout: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. No grid lines. Each miniature is a complete tiny scene floating in the exact center of its own quadrant, occupying only about the middle 65 percent of that cell, with a thick empty black safety margin on every side so the four scenes never touch.

Same two tiny complete figures appear fully in ALL FOUR miniatures at identical scale and baseline: LEFT a kneeling modest steel knight (closed visor, short pale-cyan plume, navy tabard, tiny gold sun emblem) AND RIGHT a seated hooded traveler in a dark-blue cloak. Two small complete people per cell, both fully inside the vignette.

Limited palette only: muted dark navy, steel blue, pale cyan, and a little gold. Flat pixels, no glow, no gradient, no text. Designed as very small terminal-game sprites.

Top-left: knight holds a small gold loaf at his chest; traveler sits with hands down in his lap.
Top-right: knight's arms stretched straight out offering the loaf; traveler reaching toward it.
Bottom-left: loaf now in the traveler's hands; knight's arms lowering to his sides.
Bottom-right: traveler holds the loaf at chest; knight's hands rest on his thighs and his head is bowed.
